import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
V=np.var(sigma)
def run(name,fn,np_,trials=60):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(1); best=None
    for i in range(trials):
        p0=rng.uniform(-2,2,np_)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: fn(p)-sigma,p0,max_nfev=2000)
            if np.isfinite(r.cost) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception: pass
    print(name, np.mean((fn(best.x)-sigma)**2)/V, np.round(best.x,3))
run("F1", lambda p: p[0]*T**p[1]+p[2]*eps**p[3]+p[4]*(eps*T)**p[5], 6)
run("F3", lambda p: p[0]*T**p[1]+p[2]*eps**p[3]*T**p[4]+p[5]*(eps*T)**p[6], 7)
run("F4", lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*T**p[2]+p[3]*eps**p[4]*T**p[5]+p[6]*eps**p[7]*T**p[8], 9)
run("F5", lambda p: p[0]*T**p[1]+p[2]*eps**p[3]*np.exp(p[4]*T)+p[5]*eps**p[6]*T**p[7], 8)
